meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你查看、添加或删除 NanoClaw 代理容器可访问的主机目录白名单(存于 ~/.config/nanoclaw/mount-allowlist.json),并标明每个目录是只读还是可读写。变更后新启动的容器会自动生效,无需重启服务。
howto.when: 当你提到 “mounts”、“mount allowlist” 等关键词,或要调整容器可访问哪些主机目录时触发。

say.text: 看看现在容器允许访问哪些目录
say.note: 读取并列出当前白名单配置

say.text: 把 /data/projects 加进白名单,设为只读
say.note: 校验路径存在后写入配置

say.text: 把 /tmp 从挂载白名单里删掉
say.note: 移除该条目并重写配置

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can view, add, or remove the allowlist of host directories NanoClaw agent containers may access (stored at ~/.config/nanoclaw/mount-allowlist.json), and marks each as read-only or read-write. Changes apply to newly spawned containers, no service restart needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "mounts", "mount allowlist", or ask to change which host directories containers can access.

say_en.text: Show which directories containers are currently allowed to access
say_en.note: Reads and lists the current allowlist

say_en.text: Add /data/projects to the allowlist as read-only
say_en.note: Validates the path, then writes the config
